geo_notes: Nominatim returned the OSM leisure=park feature 'Marconi Conference Center & Historic Park' with housenumber 18500. Wikidata Q49521579 gives 38.143056, -122.876667, about 150 m away; the two agree. The lodge buildings sit on the bay-side hillside within the 62-acre park, so either point is within the property. Address confirmed on the venue site footer.

notes: lodgeatmarconi.com returns HTTP 403 to curl's default User-Agent; a full Chrome UA string gets through. WordPress site with no sitemap exposed; ~200 image files found across home, gather, stay, the-lodge, the-park and gallery pages. Sizes on disk are suffixed -300x200/-768x512/-1536x1024, originals are the unsuffixed files (1920-4000px). The English Wikipedia article for Marconi Conference Center State Historic Park is a redirect to Tomales Bay#Marconi Conference Center. Site describes 'a 62-acre historic state park overlooking Tomales Bay', with the restaurant Mable's, Buck Hall, an A-frame, and an outdoor amphitheater. 04 caption (Mable's) is inferred from the Brian Ferry dining-room photo series on the gather page.
